Derive handler arguments with `InferToolParams`; keep the schema as the single source of truth for validation and types. 3. Define the response contract and output schema for read tools in `utils/response-contracts.ts`. 4. Register the definition through `tools/register.ts`, use the existing `ToolRuntime` error/observation path, and add a co-located test. 5. Measure token cost when tool descriptions or schemas materially change: `pnpm run measure:tokens`. Handlers receive inferred arguments. Keep manual argument casts, `any`, and `unknown` out of tool-handler code. Deterministic unit, mocked MCP, contract, stdio, package, and performance lanes use fake credentials and do not need a live key. Live Hevy lanes require a valid `HEVY_API_KEY`. Read the Worker section of `CONTRIBUTING.md` before changing deployment, origin, authentication, or OAuth behavior. ## Changesets and release identity Before every commit, classify the diff and run: ```bash pnpm run check:changeset ``` A change under `packages/*`, a runtime-visible behavior change, a workspace dependency change, or `cloudflare.config.ts` requires a non-empty bump Changeset. Name the changed package and every transitive shipped consumer from `repository/topology.json`; do not couple unrelated packages. Core, client, operations, and Worker are private but versioned for internal release/deployment identity. Node and CLI are public. You are a user-testing flow validator for mission milestone "client-seam" (hevy-mcp repository, Effect TS adoption mission).

Assigned assertions (test ALL of them):
- VAL-CLIENT-009: Shared client config — createHevyClient({ fetch, apiKey, maxGetRetries, ... }) is what Effect methods use. A custom fetch, maxGetRetries: 0 (or 2), and fake apiKey ("test-key") change Effect attempt count and the api-key header the same way they change Promise.
- VAL-CLIENT-010: GET retry-then-success parity — with maxGetRetries: 1 and mocked 503 then 200, Promise and Effect each fetch twice then succeed with the same payload. Coverage must include at least one existing read (getWorkout / getWorkouts / getRoutines / getRoutineById) and one new GET added this mission (getWorkoutEvents, getWorkoutCount, or a new list such as getExerciseTemplates / getRoutineFolders / getBodyMeasurements).
- VAL-CLIENT-011: GET retry exhaustion — with maxGetRetries: 1 and every fetch 503, Promise and Effect GET methods each attempt twice and fail; attempt counts must not diverge.
- VAL-CLIENT-012: POST mutations fetch once on 503 for both Promise and Effect; PUT attempt count equals Promise under the same 503 + maxGetRetries.
- VAL-CLIENT-013: Mocked 404 and 400 each produce exactly one fetch call on both Promise and Effect (no retry of client errors).
- VAL-CLIENT-014: Every Effect method accepts trailing HevyRequestOptions (signal?, deadline?, timeoutMs?). Passing an already-aborted signal, { timeoutMs: 1 }, or a past deadline fails with the same abort/deadline outcome family as the Promise method (HEVY_REQUEST_ABORTED / HEVY_DEADLINE_EXCEEDED or the tagged NetworkError projection).
